forum.title: The CubeMX didn't generated some .h files
forum.best_answer_content: The issue has been temporarily resolved. After I changed the firmware package version to 1.8.5, I was able to compile successfully on both KEIL and CLion. Additionally, version 1.8.6 can only be compiled on KEIL MDK v6, but not on v5.
forum.content_text:
The CubeMX suddenly can't generate some .h files such as stm32f103xb.h, core\_cm3.h, stm32f1xx\_hal\_rcc.h ..., I tried to use legacy CubeMX to generate but still the same.

How to fix it?

Left picture is what it should look like ,and the right one is the wrong one.

![Snipaste_2026-03-25_21-30-36.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/9fd4df9f-e34e-da9e-0f1b-2c2bb4bf9606.png "Snipaste_2026-03-25_21-30-36.png")![Snipaste_2026-03-25_21-30-54.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/aae4ab8b-97ec-ff87-225e-d57eecbc67d4.png "Snipaste_2026-03-25_21-30-54.png")
forum.author: AL1S

scraped_replies.html:
It only generates what it needs. There is no issue with this. If a peripheral isn't used, it won't include those header files.

If you're having problem compiling code generated with an IOC file, include that IOC file.
scraped_replies.author: TDK

scraped_replies.html: But I didn’t add anything to the generated code, and it fails to compile directly, giving an error about missing header files.
scraped_replies.author: AL1S

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @AL1S and welcome to the ST community,

RCC related files need at least to be generated.

What CubeMx version are you using? could you please attach your ioc file?
scraped_replies.author: mƎALLEm

scraped_replies.html: Does it say code was generated successfully? Sounds like your installation is corrupted.
scraped_replies.author: TDK
